about: How a commander says, on the radio, the things the panel now does directly: buying, building on a spot, a turned fence, cancelling, rally points, selling and repairing. The page no longer writes these calls; the tests keep them so the operator goes on understanding them in both languages.

en.call.buy: {to}, this is {from}. Buy one {class} squad, {unit}. Over.
en.call.buildRun: {to}, this is {from}. Build a {structure} running {run}, {place}. Over.
en.call.rally: {to}, this is {from}. New squads rally at {point}. Over.
en.call.rallyHome: {to}, this is {from}. New squads rally at home. Over.
en.call.rallyFrom: {to}, this is {from}. Squads from the {structure} rally at {point}. Over.
en.call.rallyFromHome: {to}, this is {from}. Squads from the {structure} rally at home. Over.

he.call.rally: {to}, כאן {from}, כיתות חדשות מתכנסות ב{point}, עבור.
he.call.rallyHome: {to}, כאן {from}, כיתות חדשות מתכנסות ליד המבנה, עבור.
he.call.rallyFrom: {to}, כאן {from}, כיתות של {structure} מתכנסות ב{point}, עבור.
he.call.rallyFromHome: {to}, כאן {from}, כיתות של {structure} מתכנסות ליד המבנה, עבור.
